Dynotch. Inspired by NotchNook and MacNotch.
Dynotch controls Music and Spotify, reads the current track for the notch, and switches Dark Mode from the quick toggles.
Dynotch shows your upcoming events in the notch.

Dynotch shows your reminders in the notch and lets you check them off.

Dynotch uses the camera for the Mirror widget so you can check yourself before a call.
With Live equalizer on, Dynotch listens to Music or Spotify while they play so the equalizer bars follow the music. Nothing is recorded or saved.
Dynotch shows the battery level of your connected Bluetooth devices, and connects or disconnects paired ones when you ask.
Dynotch puts new screenshots saved to your Desktop in the Tray, and keeps your notes there if you choose a folder on the Desktop.
Dynotch puts new screenshots saved to your Documents folder in the Tray, and keeps your notes there if you choose a folder in Documents.

Dynotch shows the progress of files you download in the notch and can put finished downloads in the Tray. It also picks up screenshots saved to Downloads, and keeps your notes there if you choose a folder in Downloads.
Dynotch shows the weather where you are, if you turn on Use My Location in its Weather settings.

Dynotch keeps your notes in the iCloud Drive folder you choose, so they sync to your other Macs.
